mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.0% compresses equity discount rates, reducing the present value of future cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate revenue expectations decline.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS (both down > 1% in 1 month) is followed by positive SPX 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105.0) indicates easing supply chain constraints, improving corporate margins and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rising retail sales series (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL > 245.0) signals potential Fed tightening, increasing equity discount rates and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 245.0.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) signals recessionary pressures with monetary stimulus, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5% AND FEDFUNDS < 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST > 1200.0) indicates robust consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1200.0.
